title: helloframe
tagline: a read-only no-framework hello-world frame featuring an image
description:
Didn't realize I could create a simple no-framework frame, so I created this little project for fun.

The project is hosted on vercel,  and throughout the building process I utilized frames.js's debugging tools to help me create the frame.

Obviously a very simple project created for the sake of building frames! Joined frameworks last minute to enjoy the demos & talks.
how_its_made: The project  consists of both HTML and farcaster's metatags. No partner technologies were utilized in  the codebase, though I experimented with XMTP,  airstack & frames.js throughout the hackathon & on other frames. Also, I used frames.js local & hosted debugger to work on this and other frames.
